page.text:
Our priorities
Mapel for Moraga
# Preserving what we love. Planning for what we need.
A hopeful, practical campaign rooted in listening to neighbors and caring for the place we call home.
Explore the priorities
In their own words
## What do you love about Moraga?
At the Pear and Wine Festival, neighbors of all ages shared what makes Moraga worth fighting for.
A shared agenda
## The town deserves our time and care.
I am the current Chair of the Moraga Planning Commission and I'm eager to continue to partner with the community and town leadership to ensure that everyone's voices are heard and respected. Being part of a community means showing up for one another.
Preview priority
### Protect what makes Moraga home
Thoughtful stewardship of our neighborhoods, open spaces, and everyday quality of life.
Learn more
Preview priority
### Plan for a resilient tomorrow
Practical decisions that keep services strong and prepare our town for the years ahead.
Learn more
Preview priority
### Keep community at the center
Open, respectful local leadership that makes room for every neighbor's voice.
Learn more

Community first
## Moraga is worth showing up for.
I've watched this community navigate growth, wildfire risk, school funding pressures, and the everyday challenges of small-town governance. What I've seen most clearly is that when neighbors show up — at council meetings, in school hallways, at the farmers market — good things happen. This campaign is about continuing that tradition of civic care. Not with grand promises, but with steady, thoughtful work on the issues that matter most to the people who live here.
Get involved
## This campaign runs on neighbor energy.
Whether you can volunteer an afternoon, host a small gathering, or simply share the word with a friend — every action moves us forward.
See how to help
